title: How to Safely Buy & Sell on OLX and Facebook in Pakistan
excerpt: With OloBuy, buyers and organizations of any size can simplify secure purchasing and eliminate online scams through manual escrow.
content:
Online marketplaces like OLX and Facebook Marketplace have revolutionized buying and selling in Pakistan. However, they also expose everyday users and small businesses to advance payment frauds, fake receipts, and scam deliveries.

### Why Manual Escrow is Necessary in Pakistan
Traditional payment gateways often require complex corporate setups. OloBuy bridges this gap by offering a transparent, human-verified manual escrow service.
